text:
maria: Heads-up — last night we saw a cluster of WS reconnects where client seqnum jumped ~2M after a proxy restart. That caused session GC to evict KV cache and clients had to rehydrate. Affected tenants saw token counts spike. Anyone seen this before?

chris: saw a few of those in eu-west, thought it was regular reconnect churn but the seq jumps were abnormal. logs looked like rapid seq wrap.

joel: dug in this morning. proxy sets a 32-bit seq guard in session indexer. When instance restarted it replayed a stale sequence baseline and the runtime GC interpreted the incoming seq delta as malicious/out-of-range -> evict.

maria: that explains the double billing for some routes — clients re-requested completions after cache loss. dashboard apdex also dipped because of rehydration tail latency.

alice: oof. two paths: quick mitigation in proxy (raise tolerance / transient-grace window) or runtime change (require control-plane lease before GC). both have tradeoffs.

joel: quick patch idea: on resume if seq_delta > THRESHOLD && last_resume_time < 5m then mark session "stale-resume" and delay GC for 60s while we verify with control plane. pseudocode:
```
if seq_delta > 1_000_000 and now - last_resume < 300s:
  session.state = "stale-resume"
  postpone_gc(60s)
```

chris: that should prevent immediate eviction and reduce token re-requests. But it will increase memory during incidents — need quota accounting adjustments.

maria: agree. propose creating a new telemetry counter `ws_seq_discontinuity.v1` and a dashboard panel that shows discontinuities by region/route and tenant. We can use it to gate the fix rollout.

metrics-bot: Current 24h counts: seq_discontinuities=142 (global), top regions: eu-west=81, us-east=45, ap-south=16. Median token spike on affected sessions = +130%.

alice: rollout plan suggestion: 1) patch proxy with conservative grace (feature flag), 2) add telemetry counter + dashboard, 3) canary flag in eu-west for 48h, 4) if stable, promote to global and follow up with runtime GC hardening.

chris: short-term quota tweak: make quota estimator ignore single-session token blips if `ws_seq_discontinuity` fired within last 2m for that tenant. prevents billing noise. Who owns quota estimator change? @joel?

joel: I can take the estimator change. Will open two PRs: proxy grace flag + estimator ignore. Runtime GC follow-up needs more design.

maria: thanks. I'll open the dashboard ticket and add the panel. tagging: @alice for rollout approvals. PR links once created. :thumbsup:

alice: approve plan in principle. please include a rollback playbook (how to flip flag, how to flush stale sessions).

maria: noted. I'll draft playbook. timeline: PRs today, canary tomorrow 08:00 UTC, evaluate 48h.

chris: nice. also add an alert: if `ws_seq_discontinuity` > 50 in 10m then page eng-platform.

metrics-bot: Alert rule created: name=WS Seq Discontinuity Surge, threshold=50/10m, notify=#eng-platform-oncall.

joel: PRs opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/proxy/pulls/4823 (grace-flag) and https://git.internal/r/redwood/quota/pulls/1291 (ignore-spike). Reviews welcome.

maria: reviewing now. thanks everyone.

chris: ack

alice: ack
